title: publika-techno
description: Dokładnie pięć tych samych osób z referencji publiczności Domu Kultury wstaje między swoimi krzesłami i tańczy niezgrabne, poważne techno. Zachowaj bezwzględnie ich twarze, wiek, włosy, sylwetki, ubrania, gitarę młodego mężczyzny oraz dokładny układ sali i krzeseł. Ciepłe lampy pozostają przygaszone, przez salę przechodzą niebiesko-różowe błyski i lekka mgła sceniczna.

prompts.image: Use the attached dom-kultury-publika image as an exact and mandatory cast and location reference. Show exactly the same five individually recognizable audience members standing and dancing awkwardly among the same chairs: the elderly woman in the green cardigan, the bald elderly man in the black jacket, the curly-haired young man in the black hoodie with his acoustic guitar, the dark-haired woman in the black blazer, and the elderly blonde woman in the patterned jacket. Preserve every face, age, hairstyle, body type, item of clothing, the guitar, frontal camera position, hall geometry, chairs, wall decorations, noticeboard, Polish eagle plaque, clock and doors. Change only their poses from sitting to restrained provincial-community-centre techno dancing. Keep the warm practical lamps dim and add believable blue-magenta strobe light with thin theatrical haze. Exactly five people; no substitutions, additions, omissions or duplicates; no Maia, Czesław, Halinka, DJ console, confetti, captions or watermark.
prompts.animation: Static locked camera. Exactly the same five audience members perform restrained, awkward techno dancing between the chairs, each with a distinct small repetitive movement while remaining clearly recognizable. The elderly woman in the green cardigan makes gentle side steps and small hand pulses. The bald elderly man performs stiff compact fist movements with a completely serious expression. The curly-haired young man keeps the same acoustic guitar securely against his body and rhythmically strums while lightly bouncing. The dark-haired woman in the black blazer dances with controlled angular arm movements and a stern face. The elderly blonde woman makes small confident shoulder and hand gestures. Nobody changes position dramatically or leaves the frame. Blue-magenta strobe pulses irregularly while thin haze drifts slowly through the room; the warm wall lamps remain dim. Preserve all five exact identities, faces, ages, hair, bodies, wardrobe, guitar, chairs, room geometry, wall decorations and text for the entire shot. Exactly five people. No new people, no duplicates, no face morphing, no wardrobe changes, no lip movement, no dialogue, no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts, no falling chairs, no confetti and no DJ console.
